fields.route_template: resolved router template from a reviewed per-service registry; unmatched is /other; never request.url/path

requirements: Install one terminal emitter at route entry on every Cloud Run service entrypoint
Emit exactly once per accepted request including cancellation and bounded pre-provider failure
A platform 300s timeout may preempt application terminal emission; retain platform request logs as coverage anchor
Do not union/add application terminal events to platform request counts
Route registry must be finite per deployment, including parameter placeholders rather than concrete values
Unknown action becomes none; unknown/unmatched route becomes /other
No raw URL, model ID, uid, job ID, headers, payload or raw exception in these fields
blocks: No common per-request resolved-route emitter verified in current source
Current request-log regex cannot replace arbitrary path parameters with a template
Must verify platform request-log coverage per service; sync may have request logs disabled
